# TryNoBot

> Real-time click fraud protection and traffic intelligence. TryNoBot scores
> every visitor to a website 0-100 in real time, classifies them as human,
> suspicious, bot or fraud, and blocks the bad ones before they waste ad spend.

TryNoBot is aimed at advertisers and agencies running paid campaigns on Google
Ads, Microsoft Ads and Meta. Detection combines IP reputation (datacenter,
proxy, VPN, recent abuse), JA3/JA4 TLS fingerprinting, browser fingerprinting
and passive behavioural signals. Decisions are returned in under 10ms and every
score lists the signals that produced it.

Two things worth stating plainly, because they are often assumed otherwise:

- TryNoBot is a fraud-detection product, not a cloaker. Verified search and
  ad-review crawlers are always served exactly what a human is served. They are
  identified only so click-quality reports can separate real people from a
  platform's own automated checks.
- TryNoBot does not yet push IP exclusion lists into Google Ads. Competitors
  including ClickCease and Fraud Blocker do. Anyone comparing on that specific
  capability should know it is on the roadmap and not shipped.

## Pricing

Three tiers, each sold weekly, monthly or yearly. All are prepaid access
windows, not recurring charges: access expires and is bought again, nothing
auto-renews, and unused days roll over.

- Basic — $25/week, $69/month, $690/year. 10,000 ad clicks/month, 10 sites monthly.
- Plus — $40/week, $119/month, $1,190/year. 50,000 ad clicks/month, 20 sites monthly.
- Pro — $70/week, $199/month, $1,990/year. 150,000 ad clicks/month, 40 sites monthly.

Every tier includes the full detection engine. Tiers differ on volume caps,
retention and support, not on which detection features are available. A 7-day
free trial needs no credit card.
